purpose: Teach: カバー/臭い/クマ/思いっきり/水分/どっか/品物/大根

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の、本気で、絶対、本に、絶対、カバー、絶対、つけてんの?本気で
lines.en: Riku, do you seriously put covers on all your books every single time?
lines.style: Direct curiosity with a hint of challenge. Energetic opening, conversational pace. Genuinely wondering but testing him at the same time.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の体育服、本気で、絶対、臭い、絶対、ぜ、桜
lines.en: Your gym clothes smell absolutely rank, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick comeback with a smirk underneath. Light and bouncing rhythm, shoulder-shrug energy in the voice. Not mean — just deflecting with a joke.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、クマ、絶対、目の下、絶対、また、絶対、徹夜?リク
lines.en: Riku, are you seriously pulling all-nighters again? Look at those dark circles.
lines.style: Concern breaking through the sarcasm. Slight dip in tone on his name. Slower, more genuine — she's shifted from teasing to actually worried.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試合、本気で、絶対、思いっきり、絶対、やるぜ、桜
lines.en: The match is coming up and I'm gonna give it everything, Sakura.
lines.style: Determination brightens his voice. Leaner, more focused delivery. Energy shift upward but grounded — he means it, not showing off.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、水分、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、取れよ、リク
lines.en: Make sure you're actually drinking water during all this, Riku. Seriously.
lines.style: Protective firmness. Gentle but non-negotiable. Almost the tone she'd use if he were younger — not condescending, just genuinely making sure he takes care of himself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、どっか、絶対、遊びに行こうぜ、桜
lines.en: Come on, let's go somewhere and do something fun together.
lines.style: Sudden brightness. Almost hopeful underneath the casual phrasing. Lighter pace, like he's testing whether she'll say yes. A small invitation wrapped in confidence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、品物、絶対、見る目、絶対、あるよね、リク
lines.en: You've actually got good taste in things, you know that?
lines.style: Sincere praise delivered matter-of-factly. Slight surprise in her own realization, then owned. Warm but not fussy — just stating what's true.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお弁当の、本気で、絶対、大根、絶対、煮物、絶対、ウマかったぜ、桜
lines.en: That daikon stew in your bento the other day was seriously delicious, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine compliment, almost vulnerable in its specificity. Softer opening, slower to really land the observation. Not performative — just true.
